item.title: Shift-Variant Color-Coded Diffractive Spectral Imaging System
item.description:
State-of-the-art snapshot spectral imaging (SI) systems introduce color-coded apertures (CCAs) into their setups to obtain a flexible spatial-spectral modulation. This work introduces an optical setup composed of a DOE and a CCA with end-to-end differentiable optimization.

Full details and materials:

  • Paper: Optica Article
  • Code: GitHub Repository
  • Website: Project Site
